summary: AR SALG & UTLEIE AS (org. no. 914 541 204) is a private limited company (AS) based in Lindesnes, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-11-28. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.830 (Engroshandel med tømmer, trelast, byggevarer og sanitærutstyr); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 5.4 m and net income was NOK 629 351. CEO: Rune Pedersen; board chair: Alexander Aasen Pedersen; auditor: PRO-REVISJON AS.
